// diagnostic

E0350

Jet does not have an `Any` type.

What

Jet does not have an `Any` type.

Why

A value should keep a precise shape: use an enum for known variants, generics or traits for abstraction, `T?` for absence, and `DataTree` for parsed dynamic data.

Fix

Replace `Any` with the specific mechanism for this value.

Worked example
